sources.label: Stretto docket 197 filed PDF
sources.note: Direct filed evidence states that ArcLink Fiber LLC is the Delaware buyer, that the sale covered all or substantially all debtor assets under the July 9 asset purchase agreement, that the court entered the sale order on 2026-08-06, and that the sale closed on 2026-08-07. It defines PATRIZIA Infrastructure Ltd., APG Asset Management N.V., SCIF entities, ArcLink Fiber (US) Ltd. and others as Buyer Affiliates, while separately explaining that investor-owned City LLCs are non-recourse project companies.

modelHealthOverrides: The direct Stretto PDF, not the docket index, is the application primary binding.
The Bondoro URL is a client shell and is not relied on.
The filed definition of Buyer Affiliates includes current and former affiliates; it supports sponsor-complex linkage but cannot alone establish current manager percentages.
The historical APG 16.7% must not be carried forward as a current post-restructuring stake.
conclusion: The former closing uncertainty is resolved: the U.S. asset sale to ArcLink Fiber LLC closed on 2026-08-07. The legacy UK parent, Delaware debtor, ArcLink buyer, ArcLink UK entity, and investor-owned City LLC boundary are distinguishable. Current APG and PATRIZIA sponsor-complex linkage is supported through SCIF and the court filing, but exact post-restructuring economic stakes remain NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
